responsibility: This implementation module implements LONGINT-specific text I/O in the Logitech compatibility library. It obtains and trims tokens through InOut and DynamicStrings, converts them with StringConvert StringToLongInteger, formats signed LONGINT values with LongIntegerToString, and writes the resulting text through InOut while reporting success in the module-level Done flag.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the LongIO pair: it realizes the interface from LongIO.def by reading strings from InOut, converting them with StringConvert, formatting LONGINT output, and updating Done.
